name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2026-02-05, at wavelengths from 1.21 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
